info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Serpieri Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Serpieri Battery Detail Management API enables users to define and manage detailed specifications for Serpieri batteries within the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to submit information related to battery characteristics, performance metrics, and compliance data. Typical consumers include product managers and engineers who are involved in product lifecycle management and inventory systems. This API is essential for maintaining up-to-date product information and ensuring regulatory compliance.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create the details for a Serpieri battery. Provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully add a new battery's details.

requestBody.description: Send details to perform operations related to the Serpieri battery. This request body contains the necessary information required for the operation in JSON format.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the details of the requested resource.

CreateCatalogSerpieriBatteryDetailReques.title: Battery Operation Request

serpieri_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the Serpieri battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the operation is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the battery.

supplier.description: The supplier information for the requested batteries.

CreateCatalogSerpieriBatteryDetailReques.description: Schema representing a request body for battery operation in the Serpieri system.

Supplier.title: Supplier Information

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified.

Supplier.description: Schema containing information about the supplier of the batteries.

Contact.title: Contact Information

email.description: The email address of the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number of the supplier.

Contact.description: Schema representing contact details of the supplier.

CreateCatalogSerpieriBatteryDetailRespon.title: Battery Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the operation criteria.

CreateCatalogSerpieriBatteryDetailRespon.description: Response schema for the Battery Operations POST request. It contains information about the operation status, record identifiers, and processing details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource being returned in the response.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
